idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.5: add a confirmed one-click command that clears every Chinese note while preserving project files, directories, and path rows.

1.0.4: accept precise 2-8 character labels including mixed technical abbreviations, retry only rejected items, isolate failed batches, and preview partial successes with clear skipped-item reasons.

1.0.3: require precise 2-6 character AI labels and group all plugin commands into one Project Chinese Notes submenu in the Project view and Tools menu.

1.0.2: generate concise Chinese tree labels, choose the selected file/directory or the entire project before scanning, and persist up to 20 safely reversible AI batches without overwriting later manual edits.

1.0.1: preserve the original directory/file name and render the Chinese note only as right-side location text. Add Settings | Tools and context-menu AI configuration, editable service/model dropdowns, and connection testing.

1.0.0: first release with ordered single-file storage, Project view decorations, right-click editing, safe AI project scanning, and preview-before-write.
idea-plugin.name: Project Chinese Notes
idea-plugin.description:
Add clear Chinese descriptions to every project directory and file directly in the PyCharm Project view.

All notes are kept in one ordered, human-editable TSV file. Optional AI generation scans project structure and safe source excerpts, previews results, and writes only after confirmation.
